Question 1
?

In degrees, what is the general solution to the equation 2csc⁡x=2? Assume that n is an integer.

a
x=45∘+n⋅360∘,x=135∘+n⋅360∘
b
x=135∘+n⋅180∘
c
x=135∘+n⋅360∘,x=225∘+n⋅360∘
d
x=45∘+n⋅360∘,x=315∘+n⋅360∘
e
x=45∘+n⋅180∘
